# Libraries

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(data.table)
library(magrittr)
```

## Constants
```{r}
ZMB_CENSUS_YEAR = 2022
ZMB_CENSUS_POP = 10868136 # ages 15-64
```


# Zambia model

First edition: we have six scenarios we need to run:

1. Reduction of VMMC
2. Reduction of PrEP
3. Reduction in testing rates (skipped tests)
4. Increased testing attrition rates (dropping out of the testing loop altogether)
5. Reduction in ART availability (suddenly dropping people off of ART) (as a reminder, people only get back on ART if they are symptomatic or through antenatal care)
6. Reengagement with ART following reduction (+ Reduction in ART availability above)

The goal here is to separate out the effects of all PEPFAR-related disruptions. Do each of these one by one.

```{r}
sim.results.pop.scaling <- zmb.results.build %>%
  filter(Year == ZMB_CENSUS_YEAR) %>%
  filter(Age >= 15, Age < 65) %>% 
  group_by(sim.ix, scenario_name) %>%
  summarize(total.pop = sum(Population), .groups = 'drop_last') %>%
  mutate(pop_scaling_factor = ZMB_CENSUS_POP/total.pop)

zmb.results.build <- zmb.results.build %>%
  inner_join(
    sim.results.pop.scaling,
    by = c("sim.ix", "scenario_name")
  )
```

## Compare baseline against calib data

```{r}
ingest.file.base = "/gpfs/data/bershteynlab/EMOD/citrod01/ZMB_calib_202206/Data/Zambia_calibration_ingest_form_2022-05-19.xlsm"

obs.prev.sheet.base <- EMODAnalyzeR::read.ingest.sheet(ingest.file.base, "Obs-Prevalence")
```

Calculate prevalence for adults age 15 to 50.
```{r, fig.width=8}
p <- EMODAnalyzeR::emodplot.prevalence(zmb.results.build %>% filter(scenario_name == 'baseline') %>% filter(Age < 50, Age >=15),
                                      1990, 2040)

p +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1), breaks = seq(0,0.25,0.05), limits=c(0, 0.25)) +
    ylab("HIV Prevalence (%)") + 
  geom_point(data = obs.prev.sheet.base %>%
               filter(Province == 'All', AgeBin == "[15:50)", Gender %in% c("Male", "Female")),
             mapping = aes(x = Year, y = Prevalence)) + 
  geom_errorbar(data = obs.prev.sheet.base %>%
             filter(Province == 'All', AgeBin == "[15:50)", Gender %in% c("Male", "Female")),
             mapping = aes(x = Year, ymin = lb, ymax = ub))
```

## HIV metrics

### All ages
```{r}
zmb.results.build %>% 
  filter(Year > 2015) %>% 
  group_by(scenario_name, Year, sim.ix) %>% 
  summarize(Died_from_HIV = sum(Died_from_HIV * pop_scaling_factor),
            Infected = sum(Infected * pop_scaling_factor), 
            Newly.Infected = sum(Newly.Infected * pop_scaling_factor),
            On_ART = sum(On_ART * pop_scaling_factor)) %>% 
  group_by(scenario_name, Year) %>% 
  summarize(Died_from_HIV = mean(Died_from_HIV),
            Infected = mean(Infected), 
            Newly.Infected = mean(Newly.Infected), 
            On_ART = mean(On_ART)
            ) %>% 
    pivot_longer(cols = c(Died_from_HIV, Infected, Newly.Infected, On_ART),
               values_to = "Value", 
               names_to = "Metric") %>% 
  ggplot() + 
  geom_line(mapping = aes(x = Year, y = Value, color = scenario_name ) ) + 
  facet_wrap(facets = vars(Metric), scales = "free_y")
```

```{r}
zmb.results.build %>% filter(Year == 2022) %>% 
  filter(Age >= 15, Age < 65) %>%
```

## Check on Circumcision Coverage

```{r}
merge(
  zmb.results.build %>% 
    filter(IsCircumcised == 1, Gender == 0, Age >= 15) %>% 
    group_by(scenario_name, Year, sim.ix) %>% 
    summarize(num = sum(Population * pop_scaling_factor), .groups = 'drop_last') %>% 
    group_by(scenario_name, Year) %>% 
    summarize(num = mean(num), .groups = 'drop_last'),
  zmb.results.build %>% 
    filter(Gender == 0, Age >= 15) %>% 
    group_by(scenario_name, Year, sim.ix) %>% 
    summarize(denom = sum(Population * pop_scaling_factor), .groups = 'drop_last') %>% 
    group_by(scenario_name, Year) %>% 
    summarize(denom = mean(denom), .groups = 'drop_last'),
  by = c("Year", "scenario_name")
) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(Circumcision_Coverage = num/denom) %>% 
  ggplot() + 
  geom_line(mapping = aes(x = Year, y = Circumcision_Coverage), color = scenario_name) + 
  scale_y_continuous(name = "Circumcision Coverage, Males 15+", limits = c(0,1)) + 
  theme_bw()

```

```{r}
merge(
  zmb.results %>% 
    filter(IsCircumcised == 1, Gender == 0, Age >= 15) %>% 
    group_by(scenario_name, Year, sim.ix) %>% 
    summarize(num = sum(Population * pop_scaling_factor), .groups = 'drop_last') %>% 
    group_by(scenario_name, Year) %>% 
    summarize(num = mean(num), .groups = 'drop_last'),
  zmb.results %>% 
    filter(Gender == 0, Age >= 15) %>% 
    group_by(scenario_name, Year, sim.ix) %>% 
    summarize(denom = sum(Population * pop_scaling_factor), .groups = 'drop_last') %>% 
    group_by(scenario_name, Year) %>% 
    summarize(denom = mean(denom), .groups = 'drop_last'),
  by = c("Year", "scenario_name")
) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(Circumcision_Coverage = num/denom) %>% 
  ggplot() + 
  geom_line(mapping = aes(x = Year, y = num)) + 
  scale_y_continuous(name = "Number circumcised, Males 15+") + 
  theme_bw()
```

1. Total/change HIV deaths - broken down by age group
2. Total/change HIV acquisitions - broken down by age group
3. Total/change person years on art - broken down by age group
4. Breakdown of total/change by subset of interventions

## The calculation
Aggregate metrics over 10 years
```{r}
## All ages
metrics.all.ages <- cbind(
  zmb.results.build %>% 
    filter(Year >= 2025.5, Year < 2035.5) %>% 
    group_by(scenario_name, sim.ix) %>% 
    mutate(Off_ART = Infected - On_ART) %>% 
    summarize(Died_from_HIV = sum(Died_from_HIV * pop_scaling_factor),
              Infected = sum(Infected * pop_scaling_factor/2), 
              Newly.Infected = sum(Newly.Infected * pop_scaling_factor),
              On_ART = sum(On_ART * pop_scaling_factor/2),
              Off_ART = sum(Off_ART * pop_scaling_factor/2)) %>% 
    group_by(scenario_name) %>% 
    summarize(Died_from_HIV = mean(Died_from_HIV),
              Infected = mean(Infected), 
              Newly.Infected = mean(Newly.Infected), 
              On_ART = mean(On_ART),
              Off_ART = mean(Off_ART)
              ) %>% 
    ungroup(),
  zmb.results.build %>% 
    filter(Year >= 2025.5, Year < 2035.5) %>% 
    filter(scenario_name == 'baseline') %>% 
    group_by(scenario_name, sim.ix) %>% 
    mutate(Off_ART = Infected - On_ART) %>% 
    summarize(Died_from_HIV = sum(Died_from_HIV * pop_scaling_factor),
              Infected = sum(Infected * pop_scaling_factor/2), 
              Newly.Infected = sum(Newly.Infected * pop_scaling_factor),
              On_ART = sum(On_ART * pop_scaling_factor/2),
              Off_ART = sum(Off_ART * pop_scaling_factor/2)) %>% 
    group_by(scenario_name) %>% 
    summarize(Died_from_HIV.baseline = mean(Died_from_HIV),
              Infected.baseline = mean(Infected), 
              Newly.Infected.baseline = mean(Newly.Infected), 
              On_ART.baseline = mean(On_ART),
              Off_ART.baseline = mean(Off_ART)
              ) %>% 
    ungroup() %>% 
    select(-scenario_name)
)  %>% mutate(
    Died_from_HIV.change = Died_from_HIV - Died_from_HIV.baseline,
    Infected.change = Infected - Infected.baseline,
    Newly.Infected.change = Newly.Infected - Newly.Infected.baseline,
    On_ART.change = On_ART - On_ART.baseline,
    Off_ART.change = Off_ART - Off_ART.baseline
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    Died_from_HIV.pct = Died_from_HIV.change/Died_from_HIV.baseline,
    Infected.pct = Infected.change/Infected.baseline,
    Newly.Infected.pct = Newly.Infected.change/Newly.Infected.baseline,
    On_ART.pct = On_ART.change/On_ART.baseline,
    Off_ART.pct = Off_ART.change/Off_ART.baseline
  )
```

```{r}
adults.plot.dat <- zmb.results.build %>%
  filter(Age >= 15) %>%
  filter(scenario_name %in% c("baseline", "all")) %>% 
  mutate(Off_ART = Infected - On_ART) %>% 
  mutate(Year = floor(Year)) %>% 
  group_by(scenario_name, Year, sim.ix) %>%
  summarize(Died_from_HIV = sum(Died_from_HIV * pop_scaling_factor),
            Newly.Infected = sum(Newly.Infected * pop_scaling_factor),
            On_ART = sum(On_ART * pop_scaling_factor),
            Off_ART = sum(Off_ART * pop_scaling_factor)) %>%
  group_by(scenario_name, Year) %>%
  summarize(Died_from_HIV = mean(Died_from_HIV),
            Newly.Infected = mean(Newly.Infected),
            On_ART = mean(On_ART),
            Off_ART = mean(Off_ART)
            )
```

### HIV Acquisitions, Adults
```{r}
adults.plot.dat %>% 
  filter(Year >= 2015, Year <= 2035) %>%
  ggplot() + 
  geom_line(mapping = aes(x = Year, y = Newly.Infected, color = scenario_name ),
            linewidth = 3,
            show.legend = FALSE ) + 
  scale_color_manual(values = c( "red", "black")) + 
  scale_x_continuous("Year") +
  scale_y_continuous("HIV Acquisitions") +
  theme_minimal() + theme_bw() +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
```
